|game_text=Deploy on [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies{{!}}Infiltration]] with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here (even if inactive). Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe{{!}}Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]] flips and may not flip back. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Scoundrel's Luck]]; it is the current text. The slip of the re-made Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet shown here ([[:File:VB8-03-Scoundrels_Luck.png]]) prints this text; the Players Committee card image prints the original (see [[Scoundrel's Luck]]). The card prints an empty lore box.
* '''Original''' ([[Scoundrel's Luck]]): text of the Virtual Block 8.1 release (official text as of 11 May 2012; no copy of the first sheet printing has been found) as the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-scoundrelsluck-pre.gif]]) prints it; the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, still on 12 December 2012) prints the same words: “Deploy on Infiltration with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here. Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="cl-1281_37-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the re-made Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (still headed 11 May 2012, PDF dated 18 July 2012) added “(even if inactive)”: “Deploy on Infiltration with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here (even if inactive). Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1-remade-2012-07-18">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; re-made copy, PDF dated 18 July 2012).
